title: SpellCore Focus: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose failed casts by checking focus state, aether cost, cooldown, and awakened core rules.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: A failed cast usually means no selected spell, missing awakened core, insufficient aether, active cooldown, or a client-only path trying to do server work.

blocks.title: Reset The Focus
blocks.body: Cycle to a known starter spell, wait for cooldown, confirm the core requirement, and test in a safe space.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change spell selection, core state, or aether supply one at a time. Otherwise every failed cast looks the same.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
